references.text: Tola from Issachar judged Israel and was buried in Shamir, showing the same pattern of minor judges who died and were buried in their hometowns.
Jair from Gilead judged Israel for 22 years and was buried in Kamon, illustrating the same narrative pattern for minor judges.
Ibzan from Bethlehem judged Israel and was buried in Bethlehem, demonstrating the same formula for the death and burial of minor judges.
Abdon from Pirathon judged Israel and was buried in Pirathon, continuing the same pattern for minor judges immediately after Elon.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun describes the tribe's territory, which is relevant since Elon was from the tribe of Zebulun and was buried in Zebulun land.
